# cFlow Analysis of radare2

## Tool Information
- **Tool**: GNU cflow 1.8
- **Repository**: https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/cflow.git/
- **Target**: radare2 (https://github.com/radareorg/radare2)

## Analysis Overview

GNU cflow was built from source and used to analyze the call graphs of key
components in the radare2 reverse engineering framework. The analysis covers:

1. **Main entry points** (binr/) - Flow charts for radare2, rabin2, rasm2, rax2,
   ragg2, radiff2, r2pm binaries
2. **Core library** (libr/core/) - Command processing (cmd.c), code analysis
   (canal.c), binary analysis (cbin.c)
3. **Analysis library** (libr/anal/) - Function analysis (anal.c)
4. **IO library** (libr/io/) - I/O operations (io.c)
5. **Binary library** (libr/bin/) - Binary format support (bin.c)
6. **Assembly library** (libr/asm/) - Disassembly/assembler (asm.c)
7. **Debug library** (libr/debug/) - Debugger (debug.c)
8. **Console library** (libr/cons/) - Console interaction (cons.c)
9. **Flag library** (libr/flag/) - Flag management (flag.c)
10. **Search library** (libr/search/) - Search functionality (search.c)
11. **Config library** (libr/config/) - Configuration (config.c)
12. **Main library** (libr/main/) - Main radare2 entry (radare2.c)

## Output Types

Three types of analysis were produced:
- **Flow charts** (posix format): Forward call trees showing which functions
  are called by each function
- **Reverse call trees**: Show which functions call a given function
- **Cross-references (xref)**: Complete cross-reference listings
- **Dot format**: GraphViz-compatible call graph for visualization

## How cFlow Was Run

Two modes were used:
1. **Without preprocessing** (--no-cpp): Faster, but doesn't resolve includes
2. **With preprocessing** (--preprocess="gcc -E ..."): Resolves headers and macros
   for more accurate results

{"command": "cat > /analysis-results/README.md << 'SUMMARY'
# cFlow Analysis of radare2

## Tool Information
- **Tool**: GNU cflow 1.8
- **Repository**: https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/cflow.git/
- **Target**: radare2 (https://github.com/radareorg/radare2)

## Analysis Overview

GNU cflow was built from source and used to analyze the call graphs of key
components in the radare2 reverse engineering framework. The analysis covers:

1. **Main entry points** (binr/) - Flow charts for radare2, rabin2, rasm2, rax2,
   ragg2, radiff2, r2pm binaries
2. **Core library** (libr/core/) - Command processing (cmd.c), code analysis
   (canal.c), binary analysis (cbin.c)
3. **Analysis library** (libr/anal/) - Function analysis (anal.c)
4. **IO library** (libr/io/) - I/O operations (io.c)
5. **Binary library** (libr/bin/) - Binary format support (bin.c)
6. **Assembly library** (libr/asm/) - Disassembly/assembler (asm.c)
7. **Debug library** (libr/debug/) - Debugger (debug.c)
8. **Console library** (libr/cons/) - Console interaction (cons.c)
9. **Flag library** (libr/flag/) - Flag management (flag.c)
10. **Search library** (libr/search/) - Search functionality (search.c)
11. **Config library** (libr/config/) - Configuration (config.c)
12. **Main library** (libr/main/) - Main radare2 entry (radare2.c)

## Output Types

Three types of analysis were produced:
- **Flow charts** (posix format): Forward call trees showing which functions
  are called by each function
- **Reverse call trees**: Show which functions call a given function
- **Cross-references (xref)**: Complete cross-reference listings
- **Dot format**: GraphViz-compatible call graph for visualization
